calls.title: Growthbook <> Rubylabs - Pricing Sync
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the goal of consolidating eight independent accounts into a unified organizational structure to enhance management and data access control. Daniil emphasized the need for restricted user access to maintain data isolation across distinct projects, while Dan proposed a single structure with specific user permissions. The cost analysis revealed that one account incurs significant expenses, with Ruby Labs spending around $80,000 annually. Discussions around the Enterprise plan highlighted its comprehensive features and support, while emphasizing the competitive pricing relative to current costs. A proposal will be developed based on precise CDN request data to ensure alignment with budget goals, aiming for quick review and approval to finalize the agreement within the quarter.
calls.keywords: organizational model, CDN requests, enterprise plan, pricing proposal, access control, account consolidation
calls.action_items:
**Daniil Lebedinskiy**
Collect and send total CDN request counts across Ruby Labs' accounts by end of day or next morning to assist in preparing the pricing proposal (08:59)

**Dan Wathne**
Prepare a formal pricing proposal based on the collected CDN requests and current spending, aiming to keep costs near $80,000 per year and include Enterprise plan benefits such as full feature access and private 24-hour support (07:09)
Schedule and conduct a follow-up call with Ruby Labs to review the pricing proposal and finalize deal details (08:36)

calls.title: Growthbook <> RubyLabs - Pricing Follow Up
calls.summary: The meeting centered on finalizing a contract proposal valued at $110,000, which includes a 15% discount for signing in July. The contract covers a unified platform that consolidates multiple accounts into a single organization model, accommodating an increase from 70 to 75 user seats, with additional capacity for CDN requests and bandwidth. Current spending of around $80,000 confirms the new pricing is competitive, with the proposal set for leadership review. Support will be available through a private Slack channel, ensuring 24-hour assistance. The quick implementation timeline aims for internal documentation to be ready by Monday and seeks a contract signing by the following Friday to lock in terms and discounts, emphasizing clear communication throughout.
calls.keywords: Unified Billing, Pricing Proposal, CDN Usage, Platform Features, Support Services, Order Form
